title: One session is now one folder and one URL

owner_note.text: Merged: a session's dated folder is its page, and the old /sessions/<id>/ URL redirects to it. This session's three folders are now one, done by script with a manifest, and the originals are moved aside. Its identity check passes on the tracking page. Still open: Servex needs a restart to pick up the Agents.js and turn-cost changes, and the VS Code tab caller is a proposal (it needs a .mcp.json change).
